description.value:
Prerequisites: Companion (Animal, Mount, Automaton, Bone Commander, etc.) class feature or familiar class feature (or feat)

Benefit: The abilities of your companion or familiar are calculated as though your class were 4 levels higher, to a maximum effective class level equal to your character level.

system.requirements: Companion (Animal, Mount, Automaton, Bone Commander, etc.) class feature or familiar class feature (or feat)
